description: This file defines the LaunchAgentManager enum responsible for managing launch agents on macOS. It includes methods to check the status, enable or disable launch agents, generate plist contents, and execute launchctl commands asynchronously.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent is currently active by running a 'print' command via launchctl.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent. When enabling, it writes the plist and loads it; when disabling, it unloads and removes the plist.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Writes the launch agent plist content to disk based on the provided bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Generates the contents of the plist file as a string, embedding paths and environment variables.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Executes launchctl commands asynchronously and returns the process's termination status.
